narrative.overview: ProcessPilot reads like a lean value-stream worksheet put on a screen: the analyst's question is "where do the days go?", and the answer is drawn, not described. The interface is a working tool for long desktop sessions: noun titles, a finding line under every title, a divided KPI strip, ruled tables, flat surfaces, teal only on data and the one primary action.
keyCharacteristics: One hue family, petrol teal, on data and the primary action only.
IBM Plex Sans for everything; IBM Plex Mono for evidence IDs and nothing else.
Flat at rest: 1px borders and tone steps, no shadows on resting surfaces.
Every claim sits beside the evidence it cites; estimates are always labelled ESTIMATE.
True neutral darks; no navy, no slate.

rules.name: The Data-Not-Chrome Rule
rules.body: Teal marks data and the one primary action of a form. Navigation, tabs and selected segments keep ink labels; their selection shows as a tint, a border or an underline.

rules.name: The Two-Teal Rule
rules.body: Dark mode uses two teals: a deep one under white labels, a bright one for data and text. Never set the deep one as text on the dark ground (under 4.5:1).

rules.name: The Cite-In-Mono Rule
rules.body: Monospace appears only on evidence IDs and run ids; numbers use Plex Sans tabular figures.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: A border or a tone step, never both, and never a shadow on a panel.

dos: Do put the answer to the page's question in its biggest block (the ladder on Evidence).
Do write one finding line under each title, with its evidence ID.
Do keep every number right-aligned in tabular figures, with its unit in secondary ink.
Do label every projected number ESTIMATE and draw it dashed.
Do leave the decision empty until the analyst chooses Approve or Reject.
donts: Don't put teal on navigation, tab labels or selected segment labels.
Don't add shadows to panels, gradients to surfaces, or icons in tinted tiles.
Don't use a dark or saturated sidebar, or a navy or slate dark theme.
Don't set monospace on anything but evidence and run ids.
Don't hide or dim the bpmn.io watermark.
